rca_of_issue.issue: Question labels invisible on public questionnaire page
rca_of_issue.root_cause: The Label component in PublicQuestionnaire.js inherits default styling which results in dark text color (rgb(15, 23, 42)) while the page background is also dark (#0B0F17). This creates essentially zero contrast.
rca_of_issue.affected_lines: Lines 149, 169, 189, 205, 223, 250, 278, 305 - all Label components in renderQuestion function
rca_of_issue.fix_suggestion: Add 'text-white' or 'text-slate-200' class to all Label components in the renderQuestion function, or update the base Label component styling for dark backgrounds.
